ev.q: The weighted prevalence of an audiometric notch among U.S. adults aged 20–69 years was 39.4 million or 24.4%
The weighted prevalence of an audiometric notch among U.S. adults aged 20–69 years was 39.4 million or 24.4%
Nearly one in four adults (24%) had audiometric notches
The prevalence of notches was consistently higher in males than in females
Logistic regression was performed to evaluate the notch prevalence among age groups
NHANES † is a continuous, cross-sectional health interview and examination survey

methods_quotes.q: Logistic regression was performed to evaluate the notch prevalence among age groups and its association with sociodemographic factors
Statistical analyses were weighted as recommended for NHANES data.
Statistical difference at p<0.5 compared with the referent group.
Audiograms were not accepted if the test and retest results were greater of 10 dB.
